title: No acceptance in zero steps
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $x$ be a binary input. There is no choice word of length zero for which the run from the initial configuration on $x$ halts with output exactly the one-bit string $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
